summary: ZEO ScientifiX filed a Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting via Item 8.01 a press release announcing planned geographic expansion into Georgia and Tennessee, not a transaction. The expansion follows Georgia House Bill 1275, signed May 11, 2026, and Tennessee House Bill 2246, signed May 19, 2026, which establish state frameworks for certain stem cell and regenerative medicine therapies. No financial terms, securities issuance, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. The registrant remains an OTCQB-listed issuer with no exchange-listed securities. Watch for operational execution and any future capital-raising or licensing activity rather than deal terms.
